messages: Do. Or do not. There is no try. — ship it.
It's dangerous to go alone. Take this green build and deploy.
The cake is not a lie. Pipeline's green — go.
A winner is you. Yeet to prod.
What a time to be alive. Deploy away.
It's dangerous to go alone at 3 AM. Go to bed.
Winter is coming. So is your on-call page. Sleep.
You shall not pass... this commit at 3 AM.
Good night, sweet prince. Not tonight.
Nobody's awake to catch you. Rest, hero.
Why so serious? It's Saturday. Step away.
Life moves pretty fast. It's the weekend — go touch grass.
The first rule of weekend club: you do not deploy.
You were the chosen one — to rest, not to deploy.
What do we say to a weekend deploy? Not today.
One does not simply deploy on a Friday.
Houston, we have a Friday deploy.
It's a trap! Friday deploy, weekend incident.
I have a bad feeling about this Friday push.
Say hello to my little rollback. Not on a Friday.
You shall not deploy on a holiday.
Frankly, my dear, it's a holiday. Don't.
Live long and prosper. Deploy some other day.
It's a holiday. Even the cake gets a day off.
What do we say to a holiday deploy? Not today.
Holiday's coming. Don't light the fuse tonight.
I'll be back... after the holiday. Don't deploy.
Houston, there's a holiday tomorrow.
A deploy right before a holiday? What could go wrong. Everything.
It's a trap. Ship after the holiday.
